finding.summary: A diagnostic-only event changes the immutable diagnostics snapshot but does not notify the subscription used by the settings diagnostics UI.
evidence: PluginHost.record replaces the diagnostics array (bounded to100) but never notifies. reportRenderError calls record alone; an already active command failure and sync/async source subscription failure can also record without publish.

Existing subscription-isolation test reads getDiagnostics directly and verifies continuation/cleanup; it does not observe notifications or mounted settings refresh. Activation/disposal paths that subsequently publish may incidentally reveal the entry.
finding.inference: An already mounted settings panel can retain stale count/list until another render or unrelated host publish. This is source-level inference, not a reproduced browser failure, and does not invalidate prior isolation tests.

proposal: Reuse the same host and bounded diagnostic store. At the next legal plugin-host owner segment give diagnostics an explicit stable subscription and notify it when record changes; unsubscribe/dispose must clear its listeners.
Prefer not rebuilding every slot/registry snapshot merely to refresh diagnostics. Preserve original error isolation; diagnostic observer handling must not recurse into recording endlessly.

Add focused meaningful notification/cleanup regression using an already active plugin; ensure snapshot stable on reads, new on diagnostic, and unrelated slot snapshots/listeners unaffected. A later existing mounted settings fixture should confirm visible count update without navigation.
notInScope: No new task, registry, scheduler, background monitor, resource run or immediate cross-owner edit.
No performance improvement claimed without measurement. No forced all-plugin re-render fix.
Current Arc and login delivery remain priority; original WPF-001-05/plugin-host scope owns implementation.

skillsApplied.application: Keep notification ownership inside the existing host rather than a second diagnostics system.
Separate diagnostic change publication from slot rebuilding; preserve single error ownership and disposal.
Check store snapshot identity and avoid unnecessary broad subscriptions.

sourceReference.paraphrase: Store mutations must notify the subscribed callback so React can read and compare the snapshot.

cleanCodeReview.finding: Missing matching notification for one external-store mutation; existing bounded100 history retained.
cleanCodeReview.remaining: Original owner legal scope and bounded verification required.
